notes: Run order: Login first to auto-save token, then List Categories to auto-save category_id, then Concerns/Events. Analytics endpoints: Location Report PDF, Monthly Filter, Quarterly Filter (Q1-Q4), Yearly Filter, Period Comparison, Period Comparison PDF. New filtering supports period-based queries (monthly, quarterly, yearly, custom) with compare_periods parameter for period-over-period analysis. Period Comparison PDF generates downloadable PDF reports.
